Backstory: 
Daughter of an elf general, who, while raiding a human village raped one of the woman and ended up getting her pregnant. After having giving birth, incapable of even looking at her daughter without remembering the trauma she experienced, her mother left her on the border of the elven lands, in the hope someone would find her and give her the love she would never be able to. Thankfully that’s exactly what happened, well, kind of.  
Odessa was found in her little basket by Satriya Merikh, who took the babe in to live with her and her husband Eryx. Odessa had a happy childhood, everything considered, her adopted parents doted on her and, even not being in the most financially stable conditions, made sure she never had to ask for anything. She grew up kind and sweet, incredibly energetic and playful. She’d help her mother (Satriya) with her garden, where she learned about all kinds of plants and their uses (good and bad), and her father (Eryx) would take her hunting, much to her mothers dismay, however he deemed it necessary Odessa learn how to protect herself.  
However, it wasn’t long until their little piece of paradise was decimated. You see, they lived in a small cabin in the middle of the woods, not incredibly well guarded other than a barrier created by her mothers runic magic, and Valkor, the one eyed Mastiff her father found wounded in the forest, who, now healed, had gained an affection to the family and established himself as their protector.  
On the night of her 13th birthday, an elven party led by Valen Healoris, a legendary elven general renowned for his ruthlessness in battle and his affinity for bloodshed, attacked. Somehow destroying the barrier and killing Valkor, the group made their way inside the house in search of the traitor Eryx Merikh, who had deserted their army many years ago, taking with him secrets about their people that should never be uncovered. With just enough time to wake Odessa and hide her in a small alcove, her parents were questioned, tortured, and eventually killed. And even though she didn’t see it happen with her own eyes, Odessa could hear their begging and their screams, no matter how hard she’d pressed her hands to her ears.  
Unable to move from her place in the alcove, terrified of what she would find when she did, Odessa remained there for 3 days, until she was found by Rhael. Head of The Venom-Weavers, a prolific assassins guild specialising in poisons and knife combat, and friend to her father who had been able to send a distress signal just before meeting his end.  
Rhael took her in, promising vengeance against the one responsible for the deaths of her parents if she were strong enough to make it through the ranks of the Weavers. And that’s exactly what she’s been doing for the past 65 years, training in the arts of stealth and acrobatics, knife wielding and poison brewing, taking up contracts and rising in the ranks, all in hope of one day finding Valen Healoris and make him pay for what he did to the only people she had ever loved.  
Little did she know, that he was, indeed, her biological father.  

Personality traits: 
Deep trauma, has turned her into a cold, merciless person, who is very goal oriented and headstrong, preferring to depend solely on herself. Having lost the only people that she has ever loved, have made it so that she is terrified of getting close with others again, for fear of loosing them too. 
Beneath that exterior though, she is someone who longs for companionship and fun, she is extremely adventurous, curious and kindhearted. She just needs the right people to get her to open up. 

Ideals: 
The image of paralyzing Valen Healoris and torturing him for days until he is nothing more than an unrecognizable pile of flesh, is the one thing that has kept her going for the last 65 years. She will do absolutely anything it takes to achieve this goal.
